arxiv-2201-05004.title: Reply to ‘Comment on “Proper and improper chiral magnetic interactions” ’
arxiv-2201-05004.creator: Manuel dos Santos Dias, Sascha Brinker, András Lászlóffy, Bendegúz Nyári, Stefan Blügel, László Szunyogh, Samir Lounis
arxiv-2201-05004.description: Abstract In our previous Letter [Phys. Rev. B 103 , L140408 (2021)], we presented a discussion of the fundamental physical properties of the interactions parameterizing atomistic spin models in connection to first-principles approaches that enable their calculation for a given material.

arxiv-2304-08454.title: Big Bang initial conditions and self-interacting hidden dark matter
arxiv-2304-08454.creator: Jinzheng Li and Pran Nath
arxiv-2304-08454.description: Abstract A variety of supergravity and string models involve hidden sectors where the hidden sectors may couple feebly with the visible sectors via a variety of portals. While the coupling of the hidden sector to the visible sector is feeble its coupling to the inflaton is largely unknown.

arxiv-2307-12977.title: On ordinary differentially large fields Thanks: Acknowledgments. The first author was partially supported by EPSRC grant EP/V03619X/1
arxiv-2307-12977.creator: Omar León Sánchez, Marcus Tressl
arxiv-2307-12977.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Omar León Sánchez, Marcus Tressl. We provide a characterisation of differentially large fields in arbitrary characteristic and a single derivation in the spirit of Blum axioms for differentially closed fields. In the case of characteristic zero, we use these axioms to characterise differential largeness in terms of being existentially closed in the differential algebraic Laurent series ring, and we prove that any large field of infinite transcendence degree can be expanded to a differentially large field even under certain prescribed constant fields.

arxiv-2406-06655.title: Fed-Sophia : A Communication-Efficient Second-Order Federated Learning Algorithm Thanks: Identify applicable funding agency here. If none, delete this.
arxiv-2406-06655.creator: Ahmed Elbakary 1,2 , Chaouki Ben Issaid 1 , Mohammad Shehab 1 , Karim Seddik 2 , Tamer ElBatt 3,4 , Mehdi Bennis 1
arxiv-2406-06655.description: Abstract Federated learning is a machine learning approach where multiple devices collaboratively learn with the help of a parameter server by sharing only their local updates. While gradient-based optimization techniques are widely adopted in this domain, the curvature information that second-order methods exhibit is crucial to guide and speed up the convergence.

arxiv-2412-20490.title: Highway Dimension: a Metric View
arxiv-2412-20490.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by . Realistic metric spaces (such as road/transportation networks) tend to be much more algorithmically tractable than general metrics. In an attempt to formalize this intuition, Abraham et al. (SODA 2010, JACM 2016) introduced the notion of highway dimension.

arxiv-2507-23391.title: Policy Learning from Large Vision-Language Model Feedback Without Reward Modeling
arxiv-2507-23391.creator: Tung M. Luu, Donghoon Lee, Younghwan Lee, Chang D. Yoo
arxiv-2507-23391.description: Abstract Offline reinforcement learning (RL) provides a powerful framework for training robotic agents using pre-collected, suboptimal datasets, eliminating the need for costly, time-consuming, and potentially hazardous online interactions. This is particularly useful in safety-critical real-world applications, where online data collection is expensive and impractical.

arxiv-2511-07028.title: Wavelet Enhanced Adaptive Frequency Filter for Sequential Recommendation
arxiv-2511-07028.creator: Huayang Xu, Huanhuan Yuan, Guanfeng Liu, Junhua Fang, Lei Zhao, Pengpeng Zhao
arxiv-2511-07028.description: Abstract Sequential recommendation has garnered significant attention for its ability to capture dynamic preferences by mining users’ historical interaction data. Given that users’ complex and intertwined periodic preferences are difficult to disentangle in the time domain, recent research is exploring frequency domain analysis to identify these hidden patterns.

arxiv-2511-18091.title: Proposals for realizing a Josephson diode in Atomtronic circuits
arxiv-2511-18091.creator: Nalinikanta Pradhan, Rina Kanamoto, M. Bhattacharya, Pankaj Kumar Mishra
arxiv-2511-18091.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nalinikanta Pradhan, Rina Kanamoto, M. Bhattacharya, Pankaj Kumar Mishra. The Josephson diode, a non-reciprocal quantum element analogous to the familiar semiconductor p–n junction diode, has been realized in solid-state systems but remains unexplored in tunable atomtronic circuits. In this work, we propose and numerically demonstrate the realization of the Josephson diode effect in an atomtronic circuit consisting of a ring-shaped Bose–Einstein condensate and with optical barriers serving as Josephson junctions.

arxiv-2512-00325.title: Progressive Code Integration for Abstractive Bug Report Summarization
arxiv-2512-00325.creator: Shaira Sadia Karim shairasadia@iut-dhaka.edu, Abrar Mahmud Rahim abrarmahmud@iut-dhaka.edu, Lamia Alam lamiaalam@iut-dhaka.edu, Ishmam Tashdeed ishmamtashdeed@iut-dhaka.edu, Lutfun Nahar Lota lota@iut-dhaka.edu, Dr. Md. Abu Raihan M. Kamal raihan.kamal@iut-dhaka.edu, Dr. Md. Azam Hossain azam@iut-dh
arxiv-2512-00325.description: Abstract Bug reports are often unstructured and verbose, making it challenging for developers to efficiently comprehend software issues. Existing summarization approaches typically rely on surface-level textual cues, resulting in incomplete or redundant summaries, and they frequently ignore associated code snippets, which are essential for accurate defect diagnosis.

pmc-10576820.title: Crustal structure and seismic anisotropy of rift basins in Somaliland
pmc-10576820.creator: Mohammed Y. Ali, Mohammad Ismaiel, Ibrahim M. Yusuf, Ayoub Kaviani
pmc-10576820.description: Rift margins provide insights into the processes governing the rupture of the continental lithosphere and the subsequence formation of sedimentary basins. The Proterozoic basement underlying Somaliland has been affected by multiple rifting; however, the crustal structure of these rifted basins remains unknown.

pmc-10603388.title: Guide to assembling a successful K99/R00 application
pmc-10603388.creator: Peter Michaely, Suzette J. Bielinski, Kenneth Campbell, Franco D’Alessio, Delphine Dean, Yumei Feng Earley, Robert Paine, Guy Salama, Inga Peter

pmc-10644491.title: Preoperative education in patients undergoing foot and ankle surgery: a scoping review
pmc-10644491.creator: Laura Vergara-Merino, María Jesús Lira, Camila Micaela Escobar Liquitay, Nicolás González-Kusjanovic, Sergio Morales
pmc-10644491.description: BackgroundInternational guidelines promote preoperative education for patients undergoing orthopedic surgery. However, the evidence sustaining these recommendations comes mainly from studies for hip and knee replacement surgery. Little is known about patients undergoing foot and ankle surgery. We aimed to map and characterize all the available evidence on preoperative education for patients undergoing foot and ankle surgery.

pmc-11409910.title: Efficient simulations of mobility matrices for electrolytes by applying forces
pmc-11409910.creator: Pramudit Tripathi, Scott T. Milner
pmc-11409910.description: Ion drift velocities in response to electric fields are a critical attribute of battery electrolytes. Accurately predicting species mobilities in such systems is an important challenge for atomistic simulations. In this work, we investigate two organic liquid electrolytes: LiPF6 dissolved in (a) dimethyl carbonate (DMC) and (b) a mixture of DMC and ethylene carbonate (EC).

pmc-11432295.title: The Surgical Outcomes of Modified Intraocular Lens Suturing with Forceps-Assisted Haptics Extraction: A Clinical and Basic Evaluation
pmc-11432295.creator: Yasuyuki Sotani, Hisanori Imai, Maya Kishi, Hiroko Yamada, Wataru Matsumiya, Akiko Miki, Sentaro Kusuhara, Makoto Nakamura, Kyung Chul Yoon, Yutaka Imamura
pmc-11432295.description: Background/Objectives: Postoperative intraocular lens (IOL) tilt is a risk associated with IOL scleral fixation. However, the cause of IOL tilt during IOL suturing remains unclear. Therefore, this study aimed to evaluate the surgical outcomes of a modified IOL suturing technique and investigate the factors contributing to postoperative IOL tilt and decentration.

pmc-11639029.title: Machine learning to predict adverse drug events based on electronic health records: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11639029.creator: Qiaozhi Hu, Jiafeng Li, Xiaoqi Li, Dan Zou, Ting Xu, Zhiyao He
pmc-11639029.description: ObjectiveThis systematic review aimed to provide a comprehensive overview of the application of machine learning (ML) in predicting multiple adverse drug events (ADEs) using electronic health record (EHR) data.MethodsSystematic searches were conducted using PubMed, Web of Science, Embase, and IEEE Xplore from database inception until 21 November 2023.

pmc-11792757.title: Diaphragmatic Injuries in Patients with Penetrating Thoracoabdominal Injuries without Shock or Acute Abdomen at Admission
pmc-11792757.creator: Alejandro González-Muñoz, Laura Otálora González, María Paula Fontecha Pinzón, Angela Cristina Ríos Cadavid, Cristina Judith Padilla Herrera, Danny Michell Conde Monroy, José Gabriel Rodríguez-Narváez, David Rene Rodriguez Lima
pmc-11792757.description: Introduction:Penetrating thoracoabdominal injuries (PTAIs) are associated with diaphragmatic injuries and subsequent complications. This study aimed to describe the prevalence of diaphragmatic injuries in patients with PTAI without signs of shock or acute abdomen at admission.Methods:A cross-sectional, single-centered study was conducted in Bogotá, Colombia.

pmc-12577454.title: Lactate Dehydrogenase-to-Albumin Ratio as a Predictor of In-Hospital Mortality in Predicted Severe Acute Pancreatitis: Evidence from an 18-Year Cohort Study
pmc-12577454.creator: Yaoyu Zou, Maobin Kuang, Shixuan Xiong, Xin Xu, Xueyang Li, Ling Ding, Cong He, Nianshuang Li, Huajing Ke, Xin Huang, Yupeng Lei, Huifang Xiong, Wenhua He, Liang Xia, Nonghua Lu, Jianhua Wan, Yin Zhu
pmc-12577454.description: BackgroundSevere acute pancreatitis (SAP) carries a mortality rate of up to 30%. This study evaluated the association between the lactate dehydrogenase-to-albumin ratio (LAR) and in-hospital mortality in patients with predicted SAP.MethodsA total of 4605 patients (APACHE II ≥8) admitted to the First Affiliated Hospital of Nanchang University from 2005 to 2023 were retrospectively analyzed.

pmc-13287044.title: An immunodominance perspective on a paradoxical phenomenon: discovery and modeling of ragweed and tree sensitization as negative predictors for high mugwort IgE reactivity
pmc-13287044.creator: Yuqiao Zhang, Xiyuan Yan, Fengxia Yang, Shurong Li, Xueliang Shen, Ruixia Ma
pmc-13287044.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundMugwort allergy poses a significant disease burden in Northwestern China. While sensitization to mugwort can be confirmed through specific IgE testing, the immunological factors that influence the intensity of the IgE response among sensitized individuals remain poorly understood.

pmc-13592663.title: Developing and Implementing an Occupation-Based Practice Service Delivery Model for Stroke Survivors in a Rural Thai Community Rehabilitation Center: Mixed Methods Feasibility Study
pmc-13592663.creator: Sorasak Suwan, Anuchart Kaunnil, Peeraya Munkhetvit, Hataichanok Apikomonkon, Sarinya Sriphetcharawut, Luke MacNeill

pmc-13676732.title: Intraparotid lipoma in a 15-year-old girl: MRI-based diagnosis of a rare parotid lesion
pmc-13676732.creator: Chakir Mahfoud, Hamza Bouayad, Abdelqader Sqalli Houssaini, Retal Hamza, Kettani Najwa, Fikri Meriem, Touarsa Firdaous
pmc-13676732.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Intraparotid lipoma is a rare benign tumor of the parotid gland, accounting for less than 1% of all parotid tumors. Its slow growth and typically painless presentation often lead to delayed diagnosis, which relies primarily on imaging findings.We report the case of a 15-year-old girl presenting with a painless left cheek swelling, evolving since the age of five and causing progressive discomfort, without any associated clinical signs.

pmc-13682010.title: Cumulative cgMLST provides increased discrimination of nested phylogenetic groups
pmc-13682010.creator: Armen Ovsepian, Jose F. Delgado-Blas, Martin Rethoret-Pasty, Melissa J. Martin, François Lebreton, Sylvain Brisse
pmc-13682010.description: BackgroundCore genome multilocus sequence typing (cgMLST) is a powerful method for bacterial strain genotyping. However, the size of the core genome decreases as the phylogenetic breadth of the target group increases, reducing discriminatory power. To overcome this discrimination/applicability tradeoff, here we developed a cumulative cgMLST approach, where sets of core loci conserved within nested phylogenetic entities are added.

uslaw-usc-t18-s1692.title: 18 U.S.C. § 1692 — Foreign mail as United States mail
uslaw-usc-t18-s1692.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t18-s1692.description: United States Code, Title 18 (Crimes And Criminal Procedure); Part I (Crimes); Chapter 83 (Postal Service). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Every foreign mail, while being transported across the territory of the United States under authority of law, is mail of the United States, and any depredation thereon, or offense in respect thereto, shall be punishable as though it were United States.
